Mode.Name: Device type
Mode.Hint: Automatic: Vade detects whether it runs on a phone, a tablet or a desktop. You can force a type if detection is wrong. Specific to this browser.

Profile.Name: Performance profile
Profile.Hint: Lightens rendering on modest devices. Automatic: strong on phones, light on tablets, off on desktops. The strong profile caps the map's resolution and runs Foundry at 30 frames per second.

Gestures.Name: Touch gestures on the map
Gestures.Hint: Drag to move the view, pinch to zoom, long press a token for its HUD (or to target it if it isn't yours), long press empty space to ping, double-tap to open a sheet. Phones and tablets only.

TouchInterface.Name: Touch interface
TouchInterface.Hint: Sheets open as panels docked to the screen edge (right in landscape, bottom in portrait, full screen on phones), sidebar closed by tapping the map, larger buttons, long press a button to see its tooltip.

ManageCore.Name: Adjust Foundry settings
ManageCore.Hint: Lets Vade lower Foundry's performance mode and frame rate according to the profile, in this browser only. Original values are restored if you set the profile back to "Off".

HideLowRes.Name: Hide the small screen warning
HideLowRes.Hint: Foundry warns that the resolution is too low on small screens. Vade hides it on touch devices.

Notify.Detected: Vade: {device} detected, performance profile "{profile}". You can change this in the module settings.
